flora: Primitive lily pad (small, circular floating leaf with a distinct, deep V-shaped notch)
Simple flower blossom (few petals, prominent central carpels, simple structure)
Fibrous roots and petiole (thick, translucent underwater stem connecting the pad)
Venation closeup (primitive, irregular branching veins on a waxy green surface)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; avoid wide, fragile, modern lily configurations; give the pads a slightly fleshy, rubbery edge; water elements should feel crystalline and clean.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant composition: Top-Left: a solitary, waxy green notched lily pad floating on a thin layer of teal water; Top-Right: a simple primitive white flower floating face-up; Bottom-Left: a side view of the thick petiole and root strands; Bottom-Right: extreme close-up of the irregular, non-parallel vein network on a leaf surface.
visual_logic.ground: Clear, shallow lagoon water over fine golden sand, creating a crisp and colorful baseline.
visual_logic.lighting: Clean diffused daylight with subtle reflections on the waxy leaf surfaces to emphasize texture.
